units.note: glTF converts Z up to Y up; a subject facing -Y in Blender faces +Z in glTF

texture_contract.policy: Original three embedded images, exact bytes, material descriptors and UVs preserved. Runtime TextureToon samples the base-color atlas; old 8x8 palette recoloring disabled.
texture_contract.pbr: source material metadata preserved; runtime toon mode does not promise identical PBR lighting
texture_contract.distance_lods: LOD1/2 have no images; the actor retains its LOD0 material override for TextureToon/SourcePBR.

locomotion_measurement.method: Mean positive backward velocity of foot joints in the low support window (both sample endpoints z <= 0.15m, above rest foot joint z0.112m); in-place 30fps cycle. Recalculated from fitted Haru bones, not inherited Aoi speed.
locomotion_measurement.limitation: The inherited FK gait has varying stance velocity. This is a best-fit playback speed, not proof of zero sliding or final walk quality.

rest_pose: Fitted A-pose. Source clip family Aoi DEF35; target-specific joints/weights and per-frame grounding.

face_controls.implementation: Godot UV eye shader on the unchanged source atlas; not GLB facial morph targets.

Blink.driver: Resident blink clock; sleep forces 1.0 and waking restores the ordinary clock.

TiredEyes.driver: clamp((fatigue - 0.55) / 0.45, 0.0, 0.7); narrows the painted eyes and shades the under-eye region.

face_controls.lod_policy: The actor retains one owned shader material, source atlas and eye-uniform values when swapping LOD meshes.
limits: Only two UV shader controls are implemented. There is no separated Face mesh or six-control blend-shape face.
Smile geometry remains a separate unmerged prototype. Mouth paint remains unchanged in production.
Head gaze uses the existing DEF-head rig/contact system; it is not an iris LookLeft/LookRight control.
Hair-aging masks for the generated atlas are not implemented; old 8x8 palette-cell remapping remains disabled.

production_status: Body-animation and two-control UV-eye intermediate. Smile, mouth/jaw, iris-gaze and full facial-expression quality remain incomplete.
validation_notes: Raw source immutable; derived mesh changes body width and shoulder angle, preserving hand local dimensions and UVs.
Coincident UV/normal-seam vertices retained; no destructive weld.
Four normalized bone influences maximum per vertex. Linear skinning, no cloth solver.
LOD0/1/2 share all 35 named bind poses and one surface; only mesh geometry differs.
The unchanged painted atlas is sampled by the dedicated TEXTURE_EYES shader: Blink closes eyes during sleep, TiredEyes follows fatigue; mouth/Smile controls remain unsupported.
distance_lod_texture_policy: LOD0 retains exact r1 bytes and original three images/PBR source metadata. LOD1/2 are geometry-only with one untextured material slot and no images; the actor keeps its LOD0 material override when swapping mesh and skin. Standalone distance LODs are intentionally untextured.

lod_seam_repair.method: Weld coincident vertices within 1 micrometre before collapse, retaining UVs per loop. Target-specific weights renormalized to four influences.

hand_weight_repair.scope: Local continuous palm/web skin weights only. Bind, mesh positions, UVs, materials, images and clips retained. Geometry identity is an actual array property, not SHA acceptance.
hand_weight_repair.master_method: Clean current-delivery reconstruction; older Delivery.blend retained because its delivered LOD positions differ.
hand_weight_repair.engine_visual_status: Actual GPU match inspected at the same grasp; finger-web spikes reduced. The single-joint fingers remain a stylized intermediate, not anatomical articulation.

finger_lower_body_weight_repair.rule: For vertices with a DEF-fingerN.L/R influence >=0.85, remove positive DEF-thigh/shin/foot/toe.L/R weights and normalize only the retained influences. All other vertices and attributes remain byte-identical.
finger_lower_body_weight_repair.preserved_bytes: All bytes outside the selected WEIGHTS_0 rows, including GLB JSON, positions, normals, UVs, joints, bind poses, animations, materials and embedded images.
finger_lower_body_weight_repair.identification_only: The input/output SHA values identify the assets. They are not a game, skin-contact or rendering test.
finger_lower_body_weight_repair.authoring_master_sync: Synchronized into a distinct Blender authoring copy, preserving the previous master; all three GLBs cleanly reimported.
finger_lower_body_weight_repair.runtime_quality_status: The post-modifier all-weight skin-surface matrix passes at all 72 rig/phase/progress points within 6mm, including Haru. Actual Haru GPU gameplay and LOD checks pass; see docs/verification/sewing-20261104.
finger_lower_body_weight_repair.authoring_master_status: Synchronized into a distinct authoring copy with build/16_apply_hand_weights_master.py; all three repaired GLBs cleanly reimported. Previous master retained.
